scheme_name: Medical Assistance for the Construction Workers
other_conditions: Applicant must be registered with the Delhi Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board
Must have served the Board for at least 90 days in a given year
Must have been hospitalized for 5 or more days
Cause of hospitalization must be an accident or any disease
benefits_summary: Provides medical assistance up to ₹10,000 per hospitalization, with ₹2,000 for the first five days and ₹200 for each additional day.
